About Franklin Navigator

Local information should lead to a clear next step.

Franklin Navigator brings Franklin-area resources, organizations, businesses and practical guidance into one simple, community-focused experience.

Built around Franklin

Franklin is the community hub. Williamson County resources appear when they materially serve Franklin residents or businesses, and their location remains visible.

Independent and transparent

Franklin Navigator is not a government agency, chamber or public-safety service. A listing or link does not imply endorsement, availability or affiliation.

Useful for the whole community

The site supports residents, families, nonprofits, civic groups, professionals and local businesses with free navigation and practical tools.

Designed to improve

Sources, listings and tools require ongoing review. Time-sensitive details should always be confirmed on the linked official or first-party source.

Local context stays local

Historic Downtown and the Square, The Factory and Franklin Road, Harlinsdale and the northern civic corridor are treated as Franklin anchors. Cool Springs and wider Williamson County results remain visibly labeled instead of being flattened into downtown Franklin.

No stale event promises

Dated event details are not presented as current without a fresh check of the original source. The site favors durable calendar starting points when a date, venue, price, access detail or cancellation status could have changed.

Owner

Franklin Navigator is led by Roger Gillman. Routine site and service messages remain Franklin Navigator-branded; a person is named when a human is actually handling the conversation.

Your everyday operating system for living, participating and doing business in Franklin, Tennessee.
Linked agencies, organizations and businesses are not affiliated with or endorsed by Franklin Navigator unless expressly stated. Confirm changing details at the original source.
